_readme: Reference classes the decision card shows next to every model probability (outside view first: insight:lit-base-rate-neglect-outside-view). Each class says where it came from and how it is biased. null = no honest number on file yet; the card prints 'n/a' rather than inventing one. Replace or add classes as stage 1 (full point-in-time universe incl. delisted firms) comes online. Last updated 2026-11-21.

india_survivors_2020_25_mcap_ge400.label: India, random NSE sample, mcap >= Rs 400 cr at T0, 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2020
india_survivors_2020_25_mcap_ge400.caveats: Survivors only (firms delisted before mid-2023 absent -> loss rates understated); T0 was six months after the Mar-2020 low and 2020-25 was a strong small/mid-cap bull market (-> x3 overstated). One snapshot. Treat as an upper bound for P(>=3x) and a lower bound for P(<=0.5x).

india_survivors_2020_25_all.label: India, random NSE sample (all sizes), 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2020
india_survivors_2020_25_all.caveats: Same biases as the mcap >= 400 cr class, stronger for small caps (mcap < 400 cr: x3 72%).

india_survivors_2020_to_nov26_all.label: India, random NSE sample, 30-Sep-2020 -> 18-Nov-2026 (~6.1 yrs)
india_survivors_2020_to_nov26_all.caveats: Includes the 2024-26 small-cap drawdown, so the loss tail is a little fatter than the 5-yr window. Survivors only.

us_ipo_3y_ritter.label: US operating-company IPOs 1975-2021, 3-yr buy-and-hold from first close (Ritter Table 16e)
us_ipo_3y_ritter.caveats: IPOs, not seasoned stocks, and 3 years not 5. p_ge_3x = share with BHR > +200% (6.0% + 1.3% + 0.5%). With LTM sales >= $100m the >50% loss share falls to 25.9%. Use only as a rough US left-tail anchor until a seasoned-stock 5-yr distribution is computed.

us_seasoned_5y.label: US seasoned listed stocks, 5-yr total return distribution
us_seasoned_5y.source: NOT ON FILE. Needed: CRSP-style 5-yr distribution incl. delistings (stage 1). Bessembinder context only: ~58% of US stocks lose to T-bills over their lifetime (insight:bessembinder).
us_seasoned_5y.caveats: Placeholder so US cards show n/a instead of a borrowed India number.

blowup_definition: Close falls >= 80% below the entry price at any point within the horizon, OR delisting/insolvency/suspension, OR a regulator or auditor finding of fraud or misstatement. No class above can measure this yet (survivor samples).
